Add pyrus agreement inspect public proxy

Details:
- Add agreement upstream configuration and reqwest client support for pyrus.
- Add public GET /api/v1/agreement/inspect route that forwards type plus x-app, x-locale, and x-platform to the configured upstream.
- Pass through upstream HTTP status, content-type, and JSON body, with transport failures mapped to 502.
- Document the public route in OpenAPI and keep it out of bearer-auth security metadata.
